en: Black-and-white postcard view of a broad street lined with trees and parked cars in front of a large curved modernist hotel building. The facade reads "GRAND HOTEL TRENTO" at the entrance, with ground-floor shops and a restaurant. A bus and several vintage automobiles are visible, and hills rise in the background. Handwritten-style captioning appears along the bottom margin of the image.
